text: 港股午间收盘，恒生指数跌1.69%，恒生科技指数跌2.14%。大型科网股普跌，小米集团跌逾3%，阿里巴巴、百度集团、美团、京东跌超2%。
text_en: Hong Kong stocks closed the morning session with the Hang Seng Index down 1.69% and the Hang Seng Tech Index down 2.14%. Large tech internet stocks generally fell, with Xiaomi Group down more than 3%, and Alibaba, Baidu Group, Meituan, and JD.com down more than 2%.
